电话铃声突兀地响起，打断了中信广场百达翡丽店里的安静。

林川从裤兜里摸出手机，看了一眼屏幕上的号码，按下接听键。

“林少。”顾城的声音从听筒里传出来，带着几分熟络的笑意，“深湾游艇会顶层露台，晚上七点，就等你了。”

林川看了一眼手腕上刚戴好的那块星空月相陀飞轮。

“半小时到。”

挂断电话。

林川转头看向还处于震撼中没回过神的叶知秋。

他从兜里掏出那把法拉利的车钥匙，随手抛了过去。

叶知秋吓了一跳，手忙脚乱地接住那把带着跃马标志的钥匙。

“你把车开回酒店。”林川整理了一下深灰色高定西装的袖口，“晚上可能要喝酒，不开车了。我自己打车过去。”

叶知秋握着那把冰冷的车钥匙，看着林川大步流星走出专柜的背影。

五百多万的表说买就买，几百万的车钥匙说扔就扔。

这个男人，一直这么随意的吗？

深湾游艇会。

夜幕降临，海风带着咸湿的气息拂过。

顶层露台被整个包了下来。

没有暴发户式的震耳欲聋的重低音，

只有角落里一支小型乐队在演奏着舒缓的爵士乐。

灯光调得很暗，几组高档沙发错落有致地摆放着，

桌上放着冰镇的黑桃A和年份极好的麦卡伦。

沙发上坐着四五个人。

男男女女，穿着看似随意，但每一件单品都经得起推敲。

顾城坐在主位，手里端着一杯威士忌，正在跟旁边一个短发青年说着什么。

电梯门“叮”的一声向两边滑开。

林川单手插在西装裤兜里，从容地走了出来。

顾城余光扫到电梯口的人影，立刻停下话头。

直接从沙发上站了起来。

大步迎上前，笑着在林川肩膀上拍了一下。

“要不是你中午发消息给我，我还以为你要放我鸽子了。”

这个动作一出。

露台上原本散漫的几个人，目光齐刷刷地聚焦了过来。

刚才还在跟顾城说话的短发青年，手里晃着半杯威士忌，眼睛微微眯了起来。

他叫赵凯。

家里在深圳搞建材和地产配套，妥妥的本地地头蛇。

赵凯太清楚顾城是个什么脾气了。

这位顾少爷平时看着随和，见谁都笑眯眯的，但骨子里的傲气比谁都重。

能让他亲自起身，主动走过去拍肩膀开玩笑的，整个深圳年轻一代里，一只手都数得过来。

这年轻人谁啊？

林川嘴角勾起一抹笑意：“顾少的局，有事也得过来啊。”

顾城哈哈一笑，揽着林川入座。

“来，给你们介绍一下。”顾城指着林川，“林川，林少。”

随后，他开始给林川介绍桌上的人。

“这是赵凯。”顾城指着那个短发青年，

“家里搞建材和地产配套的。以后你在深圳买房装修，找他能省一半钱。”

The phone rang suddenly, interrupting the silence in the Patek Philippe store in CITIC Plaza.

Lin Chuan took out his cell phone from his trouser pocket, glanced at the number on the screen, and pressed the answer button.

"Master Lin." Gu Cheng's voice came from the receiver, with a familiar smile, "The rooftop terrace of Shenwan Yacht Club will be waiting for you at seven o'clock in the evening."

Lin Chuan glanced at the starry sky and moon phase tourbillon he had just put on his wrist.

"Be there in half an hour."

Hang up.

Lin Chuan turned to look at Ye Zhiqiu, who was still in shock and had not recovered.

He took out the Ferrari car keys from his pocket and threw them away.

Ye Zhiqiu was startled and hurriedly caught the key with the Prancing Horse logo.

"You drive back to the hotel." Lin Chuan adjusted the cuffs of his dark gray haute couture suit. "I may have to drink tonight, so I won't drive. I'll take a taxi there myself."

Ye Zhiqiu held the cold car key and looked at Lin Chuan's back as he strode out of the counter.

A watch worth more than five million yuan can be bought at any time, and a car key worth several million can be thrown away at any time.

Has this man always been so casual?

Deep Bay Yacht Club.

As night falls, the sea breeze blows with a salty and humid breath.

The top terrace is completely enclosed.

No nouveau riche-style deafening bass,

Just a small band playing soothing jazz in the corner.

The lights were dimmed, and several groups of high-end sofas were placed in an orderly manner.

On the table was a chilled Ace of Spades and a very vintage Macallan.

There were four or five people sitting on the sofa.

Men and women may dress casually, but each item can stand up to scrutiny.

Gu Cheng was sitting in the main seat, holding a glass of whiskey in his hand and talking to a short-haired young man next to him.

The elevator door slid open to both sides with a ding.

Lin Chuan put one hand in his suit trouser pocket and walked out calmly.

Gu Cheng glanced at the figure at the elevator entrance with his peripheral vision and immediately stopped talking.

He stood up directly from the sofa.

He strode forward to greet him, smiled and patted Lin Chuan on the shoulder.

"If you hadn't sent me a message at noon, I would have thought you were going to let me go."

As soon as this action came out.

The few people who were originally scattered on the terrace all focused their eyes on him.

The short-haired young man who was talking to Gu Cheng just now was shaking half a glass of whiskey in his hand and narrowed his eyes slightly.

His name is Zhao Kai.

My family is engaged in building materials and real estate supporting services in Shenzhen, and is a local leader.

Zhao Kai knew very well what kind of temper Gu Cheng had.

This young master Gu usually looks easy-going and smiles at everyone, but he is more arrogant than anyone else.

The entire young generation in Shenzhen can count on one hand the number of people who could make him stand up and take the initiative to pat his shoulder and make fun of him.

Who is this young man?

A smile appeared at the corner of Lin Chuan's lips: "Young Master Gu's situation, you have to come over if anything happens."

Gu Cheng laughed and took Lin Chuan to his seat.

"Here, let me introduce you." Gu Cheng pointed at Lin Chuan, "Lin Chuan, Mr. Lin."

Then, he began to introduce the people at the table to Lin Chuan.

"This is Zhao Kai." Gu Cheng pointed at the short-haired young man.

"My family is engaged in building materials and real estate matching. In the future, if you buy a house in Shenzhen and decorate it, you can save half the money by looking for him."
